```
def lookahead_target(path, pose):
    cfg = _BASE_LOOP_CFG
    min_ahead, max_ahead = cfg["target_min_ahead_m"], cfg["target_max_ahead_m"]
    # try max then reduce
    for ahead in np.linspace(max_ahead, min_ahead, num=18):
        # compute point at arc distance ahead from robot projection
        proj = _base_loop_projection(path, pose[:2], _BASE_LOOP_ST["path_progress_s"])
        # compute point at s = proj["s"] + ahead
        pt = _base_loop_point_at_s(path, proj["s"] + ahead)
        if segment_free(pose[:2], pt, 0.5):
            return float(pt[0]), float(pt[1])
    # fallback: return robot position
    return float(pose[0]), float(pose[1])
```
